user_alternatives._comment: R2 only (ANALYSIS.md §1 R2, §3; CHANGELOG 2026-09-17, 2026-09-25): the tau2-bench default user simulator (tau2 config DEFAULT_LLM_USER, DEFAULT_LLM_ARGS_USER at c339866). Selected with --user-sim gpt41 in run_calibration.py and run_m1.py.

temperature_note: temperature 0.0 is sent only where the provider accepts it; reasoning models (all nine agents, gpt-5.2 simulator) run at the provider default because reasoning_effort/thinking settings and temperature are mutually exclusive on these APIs. Same convention as the 2026-08-27 gate run.
